limitations: Not fitted to a utility population; scene density ceiling retained.

Transformer cap, lattice directions and single-source scope remain.

topology_design.scope: Synthetic structural prior; not GIS, population calibration or N-1 certification

scene_profile.scope: urban construction/category selection; equipment parameters assigned in the subsequent equipment selection stage. Category probabilities are illustrative peak-snapshot labels, not measured population shares or time-series curves; geography is synthetic.

settings.selection_reason: Scenario construction, phase count, downstream endpoint capacity and observed usage frequency.

equipment_selection.selection_reason_status: Agent/user rationale proposes criteria; verified_reference_analysis is authoritative for numeric ranges
equipment_selection.physical_prior: Length/role likelihood times soft impedance-current path-drop score; not AC voltage prediction. Bandwidth, smoothing and voltage budget are research assumptions.
equipment_selection.scope: Joint observed source parameters, model ratings retained; frequency and voltage transfer explicit; no independent R/X/C/rating noise.

structure_resolution.basis: Seeded synthetic structural variation; not a fitted utility population

customer_connection.bus_semantics: Public LV connection point with a single-phase customer injection; three-phase through conductor; no separate meter drop
